import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_57/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_57/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Use all source tables by unioning them (both have the same schema)
union_df = pd.concat([source0, source1], ignore_index=True)

# Group by movieId and aggregate rating by mean to match target schema and functional dependency
result = union_df.groupby("movieId", as_index=False).agg({"rating": "mean"})

# Write the final output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_57/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
